methodology.note: Directional comparison only; rerun under staging load before production sizing.
methodology.authzOnly: One explicit Prisma authorization/scope query without interactive RLS transaction context.
methodology.authzPlusRls: RlsContextService interactive transaction: actor lookup, transaction-local set_config, then protected Prisma read.

complexityTradeoff: Backend authorization remains mandatory and is not replaced by RLS.
Every RLS-protected request requires one interactive transaction.
Identity is set only with transaction-local set_config(..., true).
Every protected Prisma query must use the same transaction client.
Missing context fails closed and returns zero protected rows.
